speaker: tutorial-guy
text: If I hit this rock with this other rock, something happens.
notes: Wiggles with a hand hint. Both answers give sparks, the guaranteed first epitaph.

speaker: narrator
text: A spark lands in the dry grass. The tribe is terrified, and also warm.
notes: First meters move and light up.

speaker: elder
text: The rock guy tried it with his teeth. He's dead. What do we do with him?
left effects: Gods +10; Tribe +5; set worshipped_rock_guy; next tutorial-4
right effects: Gods +15; Food -5; set worshipped_rock_guy; next tutorial-4
notes: People die. Either way the tribe builds him a temple, and it lasts 10,000 years.

speaker: mother
text: You're up all night staring at that fire. Are you eating?

speaker: elder
text: Someone let the fire die. The tribe wants a name.
right effects: Tribe +5; Gods +5; set blamed_animal; next tutorial-6
notes: The unexplained animal takes the blame. It remembers.

speaker: naysayer
text: Cooking meat? Raw was fine for my father.
notes: Banish him and a worse Naysayer turns up next era. Keep him and he's in every era, forever.

speaker: shaman
text: The Gods want the sparkly rock.

speaker: elder
text: Word got around about the sparks. The tribe has decided you're a god. The volcano is expecting you.
notes: The guaranteed, funny death on card 8: Gods maxes out. Promoted.
